units: Ez. XLVI, guard, trnsf. surrounding of an oven, brick-work.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 5:3">ib.</cite>, <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 4:3">B. Kam. IV, 3</cite> <he>חפר … להן ט׳</he> if he made a guard around them by digging in the ground.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 4:3">Ib.</cite> <he>טִירַת כירה</he> (Kel. l. c. <he>עטרת</he>), v. <cite ref="K00620"><he>כִּירָה</he></cite>. Ib. <he>הרי הן כט׳</he> (Var. corrupt <cite ref="S00771"><he>קטירה</he></cite>) are in ritual law like &c.
